articles.title_zh: 零排放竞赛：欧洲重型车市场发展季报（2026年1—9月）
articles.title_original: Race to Zero: European heavy-duty vehicle market development quarterly (January–September 2026) - International Council on Clean Transportation
articles.summary_zh: ICCT报告显示，2026年前三季度欧盟新注册零排放重型车约2.21万辆。其中3.5吨以上零排放卡车销量占比5.3%，高于2025年同期的4.2%；12吨以上零排放重卡销量5000辆，占比2.5%，高于2025年同期的1.6%。2026年第三季度起进入2026报告期，制造商不能再使用早期积分抵消不合规，须将CO2排放保持在2025年15%减排目标以下，否则面临处罚。3.5至12吨零排放中型卡车和厢式车销量7800辆，占比21.0%。零排放客车销量9200辆，占比27.7%。
articles.source_name: 国际清洁交通委员会 ICCT
articles.content_evidence: Race to Zero: European heavy-duty vehicle market development quarterly (January–June 2026) Market Spotlight Race to Zero: European heavy-duty vehicle market development quarterly (January–September 2026) Summary Approximately 22,100 new zero-emission heavy-duty vehicles (ZE-HDVs) were registered in the European Union (EU) in the first three quarters (Q1–Q3) of 2026. ZE trucks (with a weight above 3.5 tonnes) had a sales share of 5.3% in Q1–Q3 2026, up from 4.2% in Q1–Q3 2025. ZE buses and coaches had a sales share of 27.7% in Q1–Q3 2026, up from 23.1% in Q1–Q3 2025. Sales of ZE heavy trucks (with a weight above 12 tonnes) reached 5,000 units in Q1–Q3 2026 (2.5% of all sales), up from 3,100 in Q1–Q3 2025 (1.6%). Manufacturers faced CO2 targets for heavy trucks over the 2025 reporting period, which ran from July 2025–June 2026; Q3 2026 marked the start of the 2026 reporting period, when manufacturers will no longer be able to use early credits to offset non-compliance with the standards.
articles.document_type: 研究报告, 政策分析
evidence_quotes: ZE trucks (with a weight above 3.5 tonnes) had a sales share of 5.3% in Q1–Q3 2026, up from 4.2% in Q1–Q3 2025.
Q3 2026 marked the start of the 2026 reporting period, when manufacturers will no longer be able to use early credits to offset non-compliance with the standards.
From now on, manufacturers will have to remain below the 2025 CO2 reduction target of 15% to avoid penalties.
